entry_points: Collections tab 'HeroArchitect': Ascension_Collections/Collections.lua:52-56 adds the tab ONLY when C_Player:IsHero() (IsHeroClass('player') -> select(2, UnitClassBase('player')) == 'HERO'); panel name 'BuildCreatorFrame'; tab PreClick = BuildCreator_LoadUI (FrameXML/UIParent.lua:351) which sets cvar ShowFullBuildCreator=1 when max level or prestiged and then UIParentLoadAddOn('Ascension_BuildCreator'). The frame is <Frame name='BuildCreatorFrame' parent='Collections' hidden='true'> and is shown by Collections' TabSystem (Collections:GoToTab(Collections.Tabs.HeroArchitect) -> ShowUIPanel(Collections) + SelectTabID).

Chat hyperlink '|Hcabuild:<buildID>|h[name]|h' handled by LinkUtil:AddHandler('cabuild', ...) at SharedXML/Util/HyperlinkUtil.lua:535 -> BuildCreator_LoadUI(); Collections:GoToTab(Collections.Tabs.HeroArchitect); BuildCreatorFrame:ViewBuildID(buildID). Links are produced by BuildCreatorUtil.GetBuildLink(build) (Shift-click on a list item, BuildListItem.lua:154-160).

StaticPopup BUILD_CREATOR_FINISH_PICKING_SPELLS / _ENCHANTS OnAccept (FrameXML/StaticPopup.lua:853-875) -> Collections:GoToTab(Collections.Tabs.HeroArchitect) after picking spells/enchants in the CA / Mystic Enchant tabs.

BuildCreatorUtil.ContinueOnLoad(buildID, cb) (FrameXML/Util/BuildCreatorUtil.lua:557) -> BuildCreator_LoadUI() + BuildCreatorFrame:ContinueOnLoad (used by other addons to lazy-load and fetch a build).

BuildCreatorMixin:OnShow (BuildCreator.lua:279) sends C_Quest:SendPathToAscensionEvent('ACTION_OPEN_HERO_ARCHITECT') = SendAddonMessage('ASC_PATH_TO_ASCENSION', msg, 'WHISPER', UnitName('player')), then ShowBuildCategories and either ViewBuildID(activeBuild) or ShowBuildList (which auto-selects category index 2 with AlwaysSimulateClick -> SelectCategory -> C_BuildCreator.QueryAllBuilds).

Events that show sub-panels: BUILD_CREATOR_CATEGORY_RESULT -> ShowBuildList; BUILD_CREATOR_BUILD_RESULT -> ViewBuild (BuildViewPanel:Show); BUILD_CREATOR_CREATE_RESULT / SAVE_RESULT -> ViewBuild/ViewBuildID; CreateBuild/EditBuild -> OpenBuildEditor (EditableBuildViewPanel:Show).
No slash commands, no micro button. A GM-only chat command '.buildcreator check <player> <buildID>' is sent via SendChatMessage on Alt-click of a list item (BuildListItem.lua:163-166).

GetNumBuilds.returns: number: count of builds in the current filtered query result; installed as the ScrollList count provider (SetGetNumResultsFunction) so it is called on every RefreshScrollFrame. Must be a real function at OnLoad (referenced, not called, at BuildCreator.lua:34).

GetNumBookmarkedBuilds.returns: number: count of locally bookmarked builds (the 'History' category); 0 disables the History row.

QueryAllBuilds.args: (category:string) -- an Enum.BuildCategory value: 'None' (all, used for Featured/MyBuilds with a filter), 'Leveling', 'BuildDraft', 'BuildDraftEndGamePvE', 'BuildDraftEndGamePvP', 'Level60PvE', 'Level60PvP', 'Level70PvE', 'Level70PvP'. 'History' and 'ActiveBuild' are never sent (handled locally).
QueryAllBuilds.returns: ignored. Caller shows the Loading overlay and waits for BUILD_CREATOR_CATEGORY_RESULT(category); the result list is then read via GetNumBuilds/GetBuildAtIndex after UpdateFilter.

QueryBuild.returns: ignored; caller shows Loading and waits for BUILD_CREATOR_BUILD_RESULT(result, buildID) then calls GetBuild(buildID) again (nil -> ShowError(VIEW_BUILD_ERROR, _G[result] or result)).

GetBuild.returns: table or nil (nil = not cached yet -> QueryBuild). Fields read: ID (string), Name, AuthorName ('Ascension' special-cased), UpdatedTime (unix seconds, used with time()), Icon (icon file name WITHOUT 'Interface\\Icons\\' prefix), Category (Enum.BuildCategory string), Roles ('PLAYER_ROLE_TANK|DAMAGE|HEALER|ANY|LEADER|NONE' -> Enum.BuildRoles), PrimaryStat ('STAT_STRENGTH'.. key into Enum.PrimaryStat, may be unknown -> stat hidden), DifficultyRating (Enum.BuildDifficulty string 'BUILD_DIFFICULTY_RATING_EASY'..), LegendaryEnchant (spellID number, 0/nil = none), Upvotes (number, may be nil), NeedsRepairs (bool), Description (string of '### <SECTION>\n<text>' blocks, '#' escaped as '{HT}'), Spells (array sorted by Level of {Spell, Level, IsCoreAbility, IsOptimalAbility, IsEmpoweringAbility, IsSynergisticAbility, Comment, Flags}; Lua helpers MUTATE these records adding TalentID/TalentRank so the table must be a mutable Lua table, not a userdata proxy), RandomEnchants (array of {Enchant=spellID, Stacks, Level, Comment, Flags}), ArmorTypes / WeaponTypes (arrays of {Type='ITEM_SUBCLASS_ARMOR_CLOTH'.. / 'ITEM_SUBCLASS_WEAPON_AXE'.., Comment}), EndGameIDPVE, EndGameIDPVP, LevelingID (build id strings, '' when absent), NumCoreSpells/NumCoreTalents/NumCoreAbilities, NumOptimalSpells/Talents/Abilities, NumEmpoweringSpells/Talents/Abilities, NumSynergisticSpells/Talents/Abilities (numbers).

GetBuildAtIndex.args: (index:number) -- 1-based index into the filtered/sorted result of the last QueryAllBuilds + UpdateFilter
GetBuildAtIndex.returns: build table (same shape as GetBuild); never nil-checked (index always < GetNumBuilds).

GetBookmarkedBuildAtIndex.returns: buildID:string, immediately passed to GetBuild (must be cached).

UpdateFilter.args: (searchText:string, filters:table<string,boolean>, sort:table<string,boolean>). filters keys are Enum.BuildFilter values ('FILTER_FEATURED','FILTER_OWNED_BUILDS','FILTER_LAST_30_DAYS','FILTER_DIFFICULTY_RATING_EASY'..'_IMPOSSIBLE','FILTER_PRIMARY_STAT_STRENGTH|AGILITY|INTELLECT|SPIRIT','FILTER_ROLE_TANK|HEALER|DAMAGE') plus class keys 'FILTER_CLASS_<TOKEN>' (FILTER_CLASS_HERO for hero characters; stock tokens WARRIOR..DRUID with DEATH_KNIGHT spelled with underscore; custom tokens BARBARIAN, WITCH_DOCTOR, DEMON_HUNTER, WITCH_HUNTER, STORMBRINGER, KNIGHT_OF_XOROTH (=FLESHWARDEN), GUARDIAN, MONK, SON_OF_ARUGAL, RANGER, CHRONOMANCER, NECROMANCER, PYROMANCER, CULTIST, STARCALLER, SUN_CLERIC, TINKER, VENOMANCER (=PROPHET), REAPER, PRIMALIST (=WILDWALKER)); a copy of the FilterDropDown state with the player's own class auto-added (ApplyDefaultClassFilter). sort has exactly one true key from Enum.BuildSort ('SORT_RATING_DESCENDING' default, 'SORT_RATING_ASCENDING', 'SORT_DATE_DESCENDING', 'SORT_DATE_ASCENDING').
UpdateFilter.returns: nothing; list is re-read synchronously via RefreshScrollFrame right after.

RateBuild.returns: ignored. BuildListItem.lua:29 wraps it with hooksecurefunc(C_BuildCreator, 'RateBuild', ...) at list-item OnLoad, so the key MUST exist as a function before any list item is created. Result arrives as BUILD_CREATOR_RATE_RESULT(result, buildID, rating).

CanActivateBuild.returns: canActivate:boolean, reasons:array<string>|nil (each reason is a GlobalStrings key looked up via _G[reason] or literal text; joined with newline into a red tooltip).

BookmarkBuild.returns: nothing; adds to the local History list (GetNumBookmarkedBuilds/GetBookmarkedBuildAtIndex). Called on every SetBuild view.

IsOwnedBuild.returns: boolean (shows Edit/Delete buttons; GM level >= 4 also shows them).

DeleteBuild.returns: success:boolean, failReason:string (GlobalStrings key or text); on success caller shows Loading and waits for BUILD_CREATOR_DELETE_RESULT(result).

GetActiveBuild.returns: buildID:string or ''/nil (string.isNilOrEmpty check). Reached via BuildCreatorUtil.GetActiveBuildID/IsActiveBuildID from BuildCreator.lua:185,283,284, BuildCreator.xml:66, BuildListItem.lua:173, BuildView.lua:40,677, CategoryListItem.lua:40; called at OnShow.

GetSpell.returns: table {IsCoreAbility, IsOptimalAbility, IsEmpoweringAbility, IsSynergisticAbility, ...} or nil (nil = no filtering applied). Reached via BuildCreatorUtil.GetSpellsByClass from BuildView.lua:342 and BuildViewSection.lua:243 (pending build passes ID '' for unpublished builds).

ActivateBuild.args: (buildID:string, autoLearn:boolean, autoLearn:boolean) -- unpack of the {buildID, autoLearn, autoLearn} popup data built by BuildCreatorUtil.ToggleBuildActive (FrameXML/Util/BuildCreatorUtil.lua:520) from BuildListItem.lua:214, BuildView.lua:669,703, BuildCreator.xml:66. autoLearn comes from the AutoLearn checkbox (cvar heroArchitectAutoLearn).
ActivateBuild.returns: truthy when the request was sent (caller shows Loading); outcome via BUILD_CREATOR_ACTIVATE_RESULT(result) where result 'ACTIVATE_BUILD_OK' or an error key ('ACTIVATE_BUILD_DRAFTED_BUILD_ALREADY_DRAFTED' enables the Deactivate button in the error overlay).

DeactivateBuild.returns: truthy when sent; outcome via BUILD_CREATOR_DEACTIVATE_RESULT(result) 'DEACTIVATE_BUILD_OK' or error key. Reached from BuildCreatorUtil.ToggleBuildActive when the build is the active one (CONFIRM_DEACTIVATE_BUILD / CONFIRM_DEACTIVATE_BUILD_DRAFT popups), and from BuildCreator.xml:66 (Error overlay Deactivate button).

GetPendingBuild.returns: build table with the same shape as C_BuildCreator.GetBuild (ID is '' for an unpublished build -> string.isNilOrEmpty(build.ID) triggers SerializePendingBuild into SavedVariables). Fields read: ID, Name, Icon, Category (Enum.BuildCreateCategory string), Description, Roles, PrimaryStat, DifficultyRating, Spells[].Spell, RandomEnchants, ArmorTypes, WeaponTypes. Serialized whole by C_Serialize (all fields must be plain Lua values).

DiscardPendingBuild.returns: nothing; resets the pending build to an empty default (Name 'Build Name' is treated as unset at BuildCreator.lua:583).

EditBuild.returns: nothing; copies a published build into the pending slot (ID kept so PublishBuild becomes a save -> BUILD_CREATOR_SAVE_RESULT).

SetIcon.args: (icon:string) -- normally the icon file name without path (EditableBuildIconMixin:ToText strips 'Interface\\Icons\\'); EditableBuildView.lua:314 passes the FULL path 'Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_QuestionMark' when empty (inconsistent; native must tolerate both).

SetDescription.args:
(description:string|nil) -- concatenation of '### <SECTION>
<text>' blocks joined by '

' where SECTION in OVERVIEW, PROS_AND_CONS, ITEMIZATION, ROTATION, CONSUMABLES, MACROS, WEAKAURAS, NOTES; '#' in text escaped as '{HT}'; may be nil when every section is empty

CanAddArmorType.returns: boolean (false hides the dropdown entry, e.g. already added)

RemoveSpell.args: (spellID:number) -- for talents the current-rank spell id (DecreaseRank removes the top rank)

GetSpellByID.returns: mutable copy of the pending spell record {Spell, Level, IsCoreAbility, ..., Comment, Flags}; caller sets .Spell and feeds it back to AddSpell.

SetSpellLevel.returns: nothing (category conversion sets every spell to 60/70/maxLevel; drag-drop placement via BuildCreatorUtil.PlaceHeldSpellAtLevel)

CanSetSpellLevel.returns: boolean (drives the red X on the drag ghost; reached from BuildSpell.lua:408,415,435 and BuildCreatorTemplates.xml:167-183 / BuildEditorTemplates.xml:376-390 via CheckHeldSpellPlacement/PlaceHeldSpellAtLevel)

GetEssenceForLevel.returns: 4 values; only the 2nd (aeRemaining) and 4th (teRemaining) are read: remaining Ability/Talent Essence budget at that level for the pending build. Semantics: >0 shows an 'Add spell' slot and a level header; ==0 renders the header count disabled; the Lua forces -1 (hidden) for AE on default classes.

CanPublishBuild.returns: canPublish:boolean, failReasons:array<string> (GlobalStrings keys or text; iterated with ipairs, must be a table when canPublish is false). Called on EVERY UpdatePendingBuild (every edit).

PublishBuild.returns: publishSent:boolean, failReason:string; on true the caller shows Loading(PUBLISHING_BUILD) and waits for BUILD_CREATOR_CREATE_RESULT(result, buildID) (new build) or BUILD_CREATOR_SAVE_RESULT(result, buildID) (edit of an existing ID); result strings 'CREATE_BUILD_OK'/'SAVE_BUILD_OK' or 'CREATE_BUILD_<ERR>' (gsub'd to PUBLISH_BUILD_<ERR> for the _G lookup).

SetComment.args: (spellIDorTypeKey:number|string, comment:string) -- popup BUILD_CREATOR_SET_COMMENT opened from BuildViewSection.lua:412 and :576; equipment entries are mapped back from their proficiency spell id to the 'ITEM_SUBCLASS_*' key via Enum.WeaponSIDSubClass/ArmorSIDSubClass

SetEnchantLevel.args: (enchantSpellID:number, level:number 1..79) -- GM-only popup BUILD_CREATOR_SET_ENCHANT_LEVEL from BuildViewSection.lua:585

NAMESPACE ATTRIBUTION TRAP: ext-lua-bindings.tsv has NO C_BuildCreator namespace -- every C_BuildCreator method the addon calls (GetBuild, GetBuildAtIndex, GetNumBuilds, QueryAllBuilds, QueryBuild, RateBuild, IsUpvotedBuild, IsOwnedBuild, CanActivateBuild, ActivateBuild, DeactivateBuild, DeleteBuild, BookmarkBuild, GetBookmarkedBuildAtIndex, GetNumBookmarkedBuilds, GetActiveBuild, GetSpell, UpdateFilter) appears there under C_BuildEditor in a SECOND registration block (site_va 0x1010df63-0x1010e0cd, vs the editor block 0x1010d99e-0x1010dea0). No Lua defines or aliases C_BuildCreator anywhere in the tree and api-surface.tsv classifies all 18 members NATIVE/in_Extensions.dll, so treat C_BuildCreator as a native table whose dump rows were mislabelled; the shim's Namespaces.lua must create BOTH tables. The Lua 'C_' tables this addon uses (C_Player, C_GameMode, C_PrimaryStat, C_Quest in FrameXML/Util; C_CVar, C_Serialize, C_Deflate in SharedXML/Util) are pure Lua but live in Ascension FrameXML (not SharedXML) for the first four, so the shim's compat/FrameXML must carry them; they bottom out in the natives GetCustomGameMode, GetRealmMaxLevel, C_AccountInfo.GetGMLevel, _UnitClassBase, RegisterSavedCVar, C_CharacterAdvancement.IsPendingBuildAvailable/GetPendingRankByEntryID and stock UnitLevel/UnitAura/IsSpellKnown/GetCVar/SetCVar/SendAddonMessage. Three C_CharacterAdvancement members (CanLearnID, CanUnlearnID, GetQualityInfo) are Lua OVERRIDES in FrameXML/Util/GlobalOverwrites.lua that capture and wrap the native of the same name (GetQualityInfo native returns the quality NAME; the wrapper maps it through Enum.SpellQuality), so the shim must define the native first and then apply the override. FrameXML pieces this addon cannot run without (must be copied into compat/FrameXML): Util/BuildCreatorUtil.lua (indexed at FILE LOAD by BuildViewSection.lua:4, so it must load before the addon), Util/CharacterAdvancementUtil.lua (ConfirmOrLearnID/ConfirmOrUnlearnID/GetTalentRankSpellBySpellID/GetClassFileByDBC/GetSpecFileByDBC/GetBuildFromURL), Util/MysticEnchantUtil.lua, Util/SpecializationUtil.lua, Util/C_Player.lua, Util/C_GameMode.lua, Util/C_PrimaryStat.lua (+PRIMARY_STATS), Util/C_Quest.lua (SendPathToAscensionEvent only), Util/GlobalFunctions.lua (GetMaxLevel), Util/GlobalOverwrites.lua (UnitClass/UnitClassBase/UnitClassMask wrappers + CA overrides), GameCVars.lua (cvar registration), HelpTips.lua (BUILD_CREATOR_FEATURED_HINT), StaticPopup.lua (the ~19 dialogs listed under globals.StaticPopupDialogs), UIParent.lua (BuildCreator_LoadUI, GetScaledCursorPosition, OpenChallengesUI), ChatFrame.lua (ChatEdit_SetInsertTarget/ClearInsertTarget), GameTooltip.lua (GameTooltip_GenericTooltip), UIPanelTemplates.xml/.lua (RarityGemContainerTemplate + RarityGemContainerMixin, SpellButtonCoreIcon/OptimalIcon/EmpoweringIcon/SynergisticIcon, IconSelectionTemplate/IconSelectionBaseTemplate + IconSelectorMixin), FontStyles.xml is NOT needed (GameFontNormalHuge is stock; the other custom fonts are SharedXML/CustomFontStyles.xml), Data/Items.lua + Objects/Item.lua (FINISH_PICKING popup only). Everything else it inherits (RaisedPortraitFrameTemplateNoBackground, InputBlockText*, SharedButtonTemplate, SharedGoldRedButtonTemplate, SearchBoxTemplate, FilterDropDown*, StandardProportionalScrollListTemplate/ScrollListItem*, NineSlicePanelTemplate2, StandardButtonTemplate, SquareIconCheckButtonTemplate, CopyButtonTemplate, SpellIconTemplate, BorderIconTemplate, UIDropDownMenuTemplate2, InputBoxTemplate2, ScrollableMultiLineInputBoxInstructionsTemplate, CustomFontStyles, TypeExtensions, AtlasInfo, HelpTip, HyperlinkUtil, ClassInfoUtil, TextureUtil, GridLayoutUtil, TextureDolly, Pools, Mixin, FunctionUtil, TimeUtil, Enum, Const, SoundKit, SharedOverwrites (PlaySound), CallbackRegistryMixin, C_Hook) is SharedXML and ships verbatim. Load order inside the addon: BuildEditorTemplates.xml loads its four editor Lua files BEFORE BuildCreatorTemplates.xml, yet EditableBuildIconMixin/EditableBuildPrimaryStatMixin (EditableBuildIcons.lua) reference BorderIconTemplateMixin/SpellIconTemplateMixin at file scope (SharedXML, fine) and EditableBuildViewSectionMixin (BuildViewSection.lua, loaded LATER via BuildCreatorTemplates.xml) is only referenced inside OnLoad handlers, so the order works; BuildViewSection.lua's file-scope BuildCreatorUtil.DescriptionSection index is the only hard pre-load dependency. Runtime shape: OnShow always does ShowBuildCategories then either ViewBuildID(active) or ShowBuildList; ShowBuildList calls CategoryScroll:SetSelectedIndex(2, AlwaysSimulateClick) which SelectCategory()s the second category (Leveling on a non-max-level character, BuildDraft first in the list) -> QueryAllBuilds -> Loading overlay until BUILD_CREATOR_CATEGORY_RESULT; the CATEGORY_RESULT handler resets search/filters and applies ApplyDefaultClassFilter (auto-adds FILTER_CLASS_<own class>, or FILTER_CLASS_HERO). Category list contents depend on C_GameMode (WildCard swaps BuildDraft/Leveling for BuildDraftEndGamePvE/PvP), GetMaxLevel (60 vs 70 adds Level60*/Level70*), and level==max or GM or WildCard (adds None='all builds' and History). Result strings arriving in the *_RESULT events are looked up as GlobalStrings keys (_G[result] or result), so error keys need strings too. The build record's Spells entries are MUTATED by BuildCreatorUtil (TalentID/TalentRank added) -- serve plain Lua tables. Known bugs to preserve rather than fix: EditableBuildView.lua:369 passes self.spellID (nil) to IsTalentSpellID so 'Create from current build' imports nothing for default classes; BuildEditorTemplates.xml:283 names a global 'Text'; EditableBuildView.lua:314 sends a full icon path where SetIcon otherwise gets a bare file name. WildCard-mode paths (C_Wildcard.CanUseRapidRolling, WildCardRapidRollingFrame, rapid-roll button text) and the BuildDraft trophy path (OpenChallengesUI / ChallengesFrame) can be stubbed for a first release: the former is gated by GetCustomGameMode()&0x40, the latter by a hidden button. The unused BuildCategoryTemplate (column layout, C_Config.GetBoolConfig, C_CVar.GetBool('ShowFullBuildCreator')) and EditableBuildClassTabTemplate (undefined BuildClassTabMixin) are dead code in this addon.
